errors.text_span: Zwischen 2005 und 2007 bleibt der Wert nahe 0,28
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the value remains near 0.28. The chart shows the value continues to rise from approximately 0.285 in 2005 to a local peak of about 0.288 in 2007.
The description says the line flattens off until 2015. However, after the peak in 2013, the line first drops significantly in 2014 before rising again in 2015. It does not simply flatten.
